ui.hero.title: One platform for every animal in your care
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily operations and teamwork across all your sites. Find any task in Antz with real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Tap any card to open its guide, which has every feature and its screens.
ui.cta.text: This guide gives the features and real screens of every module. Continue from where you left off, or ask us and we will help.
ui.day.title: What your first day on Antz will be like
ui.day.2: Find your way around the platform
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles according to your organization and turn on permissions for each module, so that every person sees only what they need in their work.
ui.faq.q2: Does it run on both phone and computer?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app is for field work, such as notes, treatments, transfers and egg records. The web app is for desk work, such as the hospital system, nursery set-up, reports and pharmacy stock. Updates appear immediately on phone, tablet and desktop.
ui.faq.q3: Can we decide who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is given based on role. You create the roles used in your organization, such as zoologist, and turn on permissions for each module.
ui.faq.q4: We have more than one site. Will this work?
ui.faq.a4: Antz keeps the data of every site and department in one place. Housing is organized by site, section and enclosure, and transfers between sites pass through approval and security check-out.
ui.faq.a5: Start with the Begin (Getting Started) guide, then open the modules that your role uses. If anything is unclear, write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Necropsy
m.necropsy.intro: The Necropsy module records the post-death examination (post-mortem) with detailed observations, organ-specific findings and medical findings. It ensures accurate analysis of the cause of death, standardization of reporting and timely disposal of the carcass, and meets legal, audit and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filter
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by site, date, priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Monitor the stages of transfer, incoming, pending, draft and completed.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request information
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, cause, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming (worm removal)
m.deworming.intro: The Deworming module helps to record and monitor parasite-control treatments in an organized way, so that for every animal every deworming is given on time, recorded properly and tracked clearly.
m.deworming.f1.title: View by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: For easy monitoring, dewormings are organized into upcoming, pending, skipped and completed.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a course with fixed dates and details, or directly record the medicine given.
m.deworming.f3.title: Medicine administration record
m.deworming.f3.desc: Records dose, batch number, route of administration, notes and optional follow-up.
m.housing.title: Housing
m.housing.intro: The Housing module organizes the accommodation of animals across your sites, sections and enclosures, so that every animal's location is known and every change is tracked. Access at every level is based on permission.
m.housing.f1.title: Site administration
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit sites with role-based permissions for secure, organized access.
m.housing.f2.title: Section administration
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit sections in the zoo with permission-based control for secure administration.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure administration
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit enclosures and keep an eye on every enclosure for efficient monitoring of animals and data.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal death
m.fetal-death.intro: The Fetal Death module records and manages fetal-death incidents in enclosures, including the cause, time and details of the related animal. It helps with veterinary care, monitoring of reproductive health, analysis of trends and better population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Add fetal-death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new incidents, cause, time, parents and animal information.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filter
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by site, date, stillbirth or miscarriage, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: View dead records [?]
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full details, days after death, cause, ID, enclosure, site, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The Egg module tracks the whole life cycle of eggs, from laying to hatching or transfer to the nursery. It ensures accurate records, real-time updates and full traceability, which gives better coordination and accountability among the nest, nursery and hatchery teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Live count: in nests, sent to the nursery, marked for destruction.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg entry (nest / nursery)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parents, status, dates, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the full egg journey timeline (Egg Journey Timeline).
m.administer-medicine.title: Giving medicine (Administer)
m.administer-medicine.intro: The Administer module complements the medical record. It turns a prescription into a practical treatment workflow, so that treatment can be given immediately to one animal or a batch of animals, in the field or in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administer record for the chosen date without writing a full medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filter
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Find records quickly and narrow the list by date, entity, species, controlled substance (Control Substance).
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatments by date in four tabs, pending, given, skipped, held.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The Vaccination module manages the whole life cycle of animal vaccination, from creating a schedule and giving the vaccine directly to tracking upcoming, pending, skipped and completed vaccinations. It ensures timely treatment, accurate dose records, and full traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: View by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: For easy monitoring, vaccinations are organized into upcoming, pending, skipped and completed.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule vaccinations with fixed dates and medicine details, or directly record the vaccine given.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Vaccine administration record
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Records dose, batch number, route of administration, notes and optional follow-up.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Makes possible fast, accurate and traceable distribution (dispensing) of medical products to authorized doctors, which ensures timely fulfilment from prescription to shelf and automatic updating of inventory, with batch-level information and expiry tracking throughout.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time information on stock problems, shipments, purchases, requests, consumption, expiry and fast-selling products, with visual trends for immediate action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filter
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly find records by request ID, doctor's name or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Master (racks and shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organize storage by number of racks/shelves for immediate access and update, with customizable data (packaging, UOM, salt, driver, manufacturer). [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Stock report management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Batch-wise stock with price and expiry; mark low/expired items; keep an eye on upcoming expiry; manage escrow with dispute resolution.
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product and inventory management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track inventory and expiry, record purchase/dispatch, keep a unified ledger, handle alternatives/variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Dispense management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Doctors can prescribe and dispense, or take medicines directly from the pharmacy, everything is recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Shipment management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing medicine shipments and complete them within the app itself.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock adjustment and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record changes in stock (missing, broken, expired); keep audit history; manage returns to the supplier; download consumption, return, purchase and dispense reports for finance and demand.
m.getting-started.title: Get started
m.getting-started.intro: The Get Started guide explains the purpose of the app and acquaints new users with the essential steps to set up a profile, see the main features and use the platform effectively.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and workspace
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and reach your assigned work area.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home feed for updates, quick navigation shortcuts and the bottom panel for the main tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Pending necropsy / administration / allocation
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals for which the necropsy, administrative documentation, and after that the allocation or disposal process remain pending before the record is finally closed.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Master setup and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Configure master data, and see modules such as medical record, housing, egg, diet and animal management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personal settings
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update your profile and change language preference.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand the access levels needed for safe operation.
